Nora: pet photo dump time! meet Pickles, the ferret who thinks he's a loaf. pic: https://i.imgur.com/pickles_loaf.jpg :heart_eyes:
Ethan: ferret loaf? this is a violation of physics and also deeply adorable :joy:
Rina: Pickles looks ready to sign our PTO requests. also, does he accept office snacks or only tiny socks? :sweat_smile:
Carlos: bringing tuna for moral support. (allergies note: none)
PluginBot: reminder: Office Pet Day signup closes Friday 5PM. Please add your pet's vaccine docs to the form: https://hr.internal/pet-day :bell:
Nora: Pickles prefers kibble and weekly dramatic naps in laptop bags. will bring a tiny blanket for his throne
Ethan: Vote: lunchroom throne or sunny window sill? React :crown: or :sun_with_face:
Rina: crown if we want Pickles to feel powerful, sun sill for naps. I'm team crown :crown:
Carlos: crown. also caption contest: "When the code compiles on first try" winner gets to name our Slack emoji for Pickles :tada:
Nora: love it. thanks y'all, Pickles will be available for head pats and questionable desk choices on Tuesday :wave:
